name: release-notes-generation
description: Write user-facing RELEASE_NOTES.md for the changes since the last git tag, grouped by security, features, improvements, fixes and docs, omitting internal-only changes.
spec: Skill that drafts user-facing release notes since the latest git tag. Judgment (what users notice, wording, grouping) is in SKILL.md; a bundled script scripts/classify_commits.py deterministically pre-classifies `git log --oneline` lines (stdin or file) into JSON categories: security, feature, improvement, fix, docs, dependency, internal, unknown. Rules from accepted sessions and user feedback: omit refactor/chore/ci/test/rename/internal commits and dependency bumps unless users would notice them; put security fixes first; no invented version number.
